newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer in merger talks with CIBC - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer in merger talks with CIBC - WSJ.

text.p: Oppenheimer & Co is in the midst of talks to be acquired by CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp for about $500 million, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Friday's electronic edition, the Journal said that Oppenheimer, in the market for a buyer for the past two years, had not yet reached any agreement, but a deal could come in the next month.
Oppenheimer is a closely held brokerage firm. CIBC is a brokerage unit of the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.

Just recently, acquisition talks with Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Dutch bank, Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV fell apart. More recently, PNC Bank Corp broke off its negotiations to acquire Oppenheimer for $500 million.
